title: Draw & Guess
summary: Draw and guess with friends using Agora Whiteboard and voice chat. Race FastH3 as it turns a correct guess into verified video proof.
compactSummary: Draw it. Guess it. Beat FastH3.
thumbnailAlt: English Draw & Guess illustrated cover showing a cat sketch becoming video, with Agora Realtime and FastH3 Video Proof labels
demoNote: English interface. Two human players are needed to start. The optional AI challenger requires a host-provided Reactor API key.

title: DashLens
summary: Point your phone at the dashboard and ask what a light means. A vision voice agent answers from your car's own owner's manual and shows the roadside helpline when it's urgent.
compactSummary: Ask your dashboard what that light means.
thumbnailAlt: DashLens cover: the app showing a red engine temperature warning with a stop card and the roadside helpline, next to the DashLens logo and tagline
demoNote: Android app. Microphone and camera needed; the FastAPI server must be reachable over HTTPS (e.g. ngrok).
